n: Day of AI: How Do Machines Learn?
t: A Day of AI unit on supervised learning with Teachable Machine and bias.
steps: Find the unit on the Day of AI site.
Register or log in to see the educator guide and student resources.
Read the Day of AI privacy notice.
Choose the age version for your class.
Test Teachable Machine with a webcam or image files.
Decide whether students will use the webcam.
Plan about 2 to 3 hours in total.
